description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'NoProvisioningCriteriaDefinitionFound' used in the provisioning module of the Fineract accounting system. It extends an abstract exception class to indicate a specific 'not found' error related to provisioning criteria definitions.

classes.name: NoProvisioningCriteriaDefinitionFound
classes.description: A specific exception class that indicates no provisioning criteria definitions were found, extending the generic resource not found exception.

methods.name: NoProvisioningCriteriaDefinitionFound
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error code and message indicating the absence of provisioning criteria definitions.
